links.note: who wrote 'Deewanon ki Hasti' -- 32189 is the opening-line concept that carries the poem's identity; no concept names the poet
whose hasti the poem speaks of -- 32189 is 'hum deewanon ki kya hasti'. NOTE: the marked option 'aam logon ki' is an answer-key defect; the poem says deewanon ki
what they become among people who live full of masti -> ullas; 32191 is 'ullas bankar aaye abhi, aansoo bankar bah chale abhi'
what attitude they hold towards the world -> one of equality; 32193 is the took-from-the-world, gave-to-the-world reciprocity
whose world this is -> the beggars'; 32195 is 'bhikhmangon ki is duniya mein swachchhand pyar lutakar chale'
what the deewane regret -> not having made people mast; 32195 is the asafalta ka bhaar carried on the heart
